features.label: opencode
features.description: The opencode coding agent, from npm. The version is `rookery_opencode_cli_version` in the profile's ansible_vars. Adds its sign-in to the overview.
features.summary: opencode (`opencode`). `opencode auth list` shows configured provider credentials.

actions.name: status
actions.label: opencode sign-in
actions.help: Whether opencode has provider credentials for the agent account. Part of "Show who is signed in".
actions.run: echo '── opencode'; opencode auth list 2>&1; echo

actions.name: login
actions.label: Sign in to opencode
actions.help: Runs opencode auth login on the host as the agent and shows its link here. Open the link in your own browser and sign in.
actions.run: env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY BROWSER=echo opencode auth login; echo; opencode auth list

actions.name: update
actions.label: Update opencode
actions.help: Bring opencode to its latest version from npm. Part of Update. The version in the profile is the least one; a newer one stays when the configuration is applied again.
actions.run: echo; echo '── opencode'; npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel error opencode-ai@latest && opencode --version
